about: Two pictures in which the means, or the two posteriors one at a time, do not settle the direction probability. The joint-law panel (v1 L-07 Deeper box 2): the law's cells, both margins (engine finiteLawMargins), pi_AB and pi_BA and the tie probability t (finiteLawPairwise) and pi_AB + pi_BA (tieLawPairwise); laws 1 and 2 against the base-R oracle rows finiteLawPairwise-tb09-Q1 and -Q2, finiteLawMargins-tb09-Q1 and -Q2 (oracle-v3) and v1's frozen registry (tb09.*, settings.tb09.state); the independence law's margins against oracle-v3's nine-cell row; an edited law with the oracle's tie law (finiteLawPairwise-m4-ties, masses .1, .4, .5 as counts 1, 4, 5). The two-bump panel (v1 L-07 Deeper box 3): per-bump pi (pairDirection), the whole pi (mixturePairDirection) and A's mean (rankSummaries of the bump centers) against the oracle rows and the registry (cf.mix.*, settings.mix.*). Ported from v1's joint-q1, joint-q2, mixture-w20, mixture-w50 and update-deeper cases: the deeper key is gone (both panels show at once), the misreading boxes' expectations were dropped with the boxes, law Q1 and Q2 are law 1 and law 2, the slider and figure indices are renumbered for this app. New in v3: the independence, always-equal and edited laws, the result and tie sentences word for word (slotted literals), and the result line at the edges of the flip range on the slider grid.

expect.about: ties: pi_AB + pi_BA = 1 - t, and tie-freeness is an assumption about the joint law (theory book ch. 9)
expect.value: The two true values are equal with probability t = ⟨joint-t⟩, so πAB + πBA = ⟨joint-d⟩, not ⟨one⟩. Tie-freeness (that the two true values are never exactly equal) is an assumption about the joint law: even continuous margins (each unit's own posterior) allow θA = θB.

The independence law gives πAB = ⟨live-joint-pi⟩ and πBA = ⟨live-joint-pi-ba⟩, and A equals B with probability ⟨live-joint-t⟩. With two bumps, w = ⟨live-mix-w⟩ gives A a posterior mean of ⟨live-mix-mean-a⟩ against B's ⟨live-mix-mean-b⟩, and πAB = ⟨live-mix-pi⟩.
